messages.subject: Re: Stan meeting tomorrow?
parts:
Yes, there's a meeting tomorrow (Thursday). We try to
meet every Thursday 3 PM (NY time). That may change
in the fall.

I'm cc-ing the general questions to stan-dev and can answer
most of them here.

On Jul 16, 2014, at 6:21 PM, Alp Kucukelbir <a...@cs.columbia.edu> wrote:

> I have a few questions that I'd like to ask you guys. Here's a teaser:
>
> - using model::write_array to transform parameters

Yes, it's misnamed. It's also configurable as to whether
you want the transformed parameters and generated quantities,
and for the latter, you need an RNG.

> - using model::transform_init to inverse transform parameters

This one's very clunky as is, as you notice here:

> - one uses vectors while the other uses stan::io::var_context,

This is for historical reasons as we read the data and inits out
of files and those defined a var_context wrapper in the form of
the dump class (it's R's dump format, with some restrictions).

> so I feel like I'm missing something

Probably not. You need to write an implementation of var_context to
use it. I think Peter just did that in C++ for arrays. We should take
an implementation and put it in one of the model utility classes.

> - questions about jacobians, their representation/calculation/storage

I think this'll have to wait to hear what you want to know.

- Bob
